captions.detailed: A compact cantilever bench arm assembly. It features a dark-colored base plate with a short rectangular vertical column. From this column, a series of light grey links extend outward in a cantilevered fashion, terminating in a circular wrist face. The arm uses three revolute joints to articulate: one connecting the first link to the base, one connecting the two main links, and one rotating the final circular wrist face.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact bench cantilever arm. The assembly should feature a dark-colored base plate and vertical support column, connected to a serial three-revolute arm consisting of two light grey links and a final circular wrist plate.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a rectangular box with slot cutouts, topped with a smaller vertical box column. Model the links as rectangular arms with cylindrical hinge cutouts and matching hinge shafts. Assemble the components sequentially: attach the base, the first link, the second link, and the final circular wrist plate using revolute articulations at each joint location.
